name: 10941 · Middletown, NY
findings: ZIP 10941 (Middletown) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10941 (Middletown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10941 (Middletown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
